selected_evidence.summary: Persistent configuration sets nofile=8192 and nproc=256; an actual appworker login session reports both soft and hard values correctly before and after reboot.

commands.command: useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash appworker && id appworker && getent passwd appworker

printf '%s\n' '# Resource limits for appworker login sessions' 'appworker - nofile 8192' 'appworker - nproc 256' > /etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf && chown root:root /etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf && chmod 0644 /etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf && cat /etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf
commands.stdout:
# Resource limits for appworker login sessions
appworker - nofile 8192
appworker - nproc 256

commands.command:
su - appworker -c 'printf "user=%s
" "$(id -un)"; printf "soft_nofile=%s
" "$(ulimit -Sn)"; printf "hard_nofile=%s
" "$(ulimit -Hn)"; printf "soft_nproc=%s
" "$(ulimit -Su)"; printf "hard_nproc=%s
" "$(ulimit -Hu)"; printf "home=%s shell=%s
" "$HOME" "$SHELL"'
commands.stdout:
user=appworker
soft_nofile=8192
hard_nofile=8192
soft_nproc=256
hard_nproc=256
home=/home/appworker shell=/bin/bash
